steps.en: Officer changes the pre-notice admin fee amount on the settings page
steps.id: Officer mengubah jumlah biaya admin pre-notice di halaman pengaturan

steps.en: The nightly job reads the saved fee settings on every run
steps.id: Job malam hari membaca pengaturan biaya yang tersimpan setiap kali jalan

steps.en: The fee is charged on every qualifying pre-notice notice
steps.id: Biaya dikenakan pada setiap notice pre-notice yang memenuhi syarat
steps.why_en: Only unpaid foreign-vehicle notices under permanent suspension qualify; other notice types are not covered.
steps.why_id: Hanya notice kendaraan asing yang belum dibayar dan disuspend permanen yang memenuhi syarat; jenis lain tidak tercakup.

steps.en: The fee is saved on the notice and the amount due is recalculated
steps.id: Biaya disimpan di notice dan jumlah yang harus dibayar dihitung ulang
